hero.alt: A cave at Qumran near the Dead Sea
hero.caption: Qumran cave near the Dead Sea, where the Dead Sea Scrolls were discovered. This photograph is contextual; it is not a photograph of an Enoch manuscript.

ethiopicManuscript.alt: Sixteenth-century Ge'ez manuscript page from the Book of Enoch
ethiopicManuscript.caption: British Library Or. 485, folio 102r: the beginning of the Book of Enoch in Ge'ez, sixteenth century.

watchersArt.alt: Gustave Doré illustration of the fall of rebel angels
watchersArt.caption: Gustave Doré's nineteenth-century Fall of the Rebel Angels. Used as later artistic interpretation, not as evidence for how ancient Enochic authors pictured the Watchers.

jamesBruce.alt: Portrait of Scottish traveler James Bruce
jamesBruce.caption: James Bruce (1730–1794), whose return from Ethiopia in 1773 brought complete Ge'ez manuscripts of 1 Enoch into wider European scholarly circulation.
